name: Closed Captions
description: Real closed captions via the browser's native <track> API — sourced from a sidecar .srt/.vtt file next to the video, or an embedded subtitle stream inside the container (extracted with the bundled ffmpeg). No caption data is invented; a file with neither source just plays without captions. Caption styling adapts to the active guide/OSD theme (see registerThemePack's captionStyle field).

ipc.why: checks a file for a sidecar .srt/.vtt or embedded subtitle streams before playback
extracts/converts a found caption source into a cached .vtt file for the <track> element to load

spawn.why: lists embedded subtitle streams (ffmpeg -i) and extracts/converts them to WebVTT
